answer: Practically, the chain should let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because ember only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. Concretely, saffron is enforced in the ledger: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any jade approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
